study: Secondary static-archive multiview information bottleneck, protocol version 1
status: Mechanism exploration on historically analyzed parents. This is NOT a new primary preregistration, independent replication, full-shell MI estimate, or comparison of microscopic dynamics. There are no newly acquired states, future labels or simulations.
release: Hash-check the L20 npz against its release receipt and preserve l20_pairs.partition at each temperature. At index 9 fit only on the 10240 training parents; score only the 2048 validation parents. Seek past all unselected rows in the monolithic compressed species.npy member. In transfer, only validation rows are materialized; an explicit fold guard forbids test loading and scoring at every temperature. Physical inference units are independent parents, not sites, shell faces, optimization seeds, or encoder states.
channel: Uniform parent, periodic center and one independent equiprobable face J. V is either all eight lexicographically ordered offsets in {-1,+1}^3 or the center followed by negative/positive unit offsets on z,y,x: separate 6561/2187-state ternary channels, no orbit pooling. At buffer b=1,2,3, the selected normal coordinate is +/- (2+b); the two tangential coordinates are the four lexicographic +/-1 pairs, ordered in lattice-coordinate order. Y_J is the joint four-species-site pattern (81 outcomes), not four independent labels. Little-endian ternary codes. Exactly integrate the choice of J using six equally weighted observations, without giving J to the encoder. The target is not the concatenation of all six squares; cubic isotropy is not assumed.
exposure: Per-parent random phase and random stride coprime to 8000 traverse a seeded permutation of every center, with shared prefixes across geometries. Each prefix is marginally uniform, no center repeats per parent, and at 8000 anchors translation averaging is exact. Cache two cumulative uint32 histograms n(v,j,y), one for the last 1024 training parents, one for the other 9216. Select a Dirichlet total concentration from [0.5,2,8,32,128,512,2048,8192,32768] by conditional target logscore on the 1024 with the other 9216 fitting the training marginal prior (half count per face pattern). Refit with all 10240; both probability of V and each shrunk conditional distribution enter the optimization. Unobserved V gets the final encoder prior, not an extrapolated label. The training-model joint need not reproduce the unsmoothed empirical joint.
objective: Optimize I(H;Y_J|J)-lambda I(H;V), both in nats; encoder q(h|v) independent of J. Use KL distortion averaged over faces: q(h|v) proportional to pi(h) exp[(1/(6 lambda)) sum_{j,y} p(y|v,j) log(d(y|h,j)/m(y|j))]. Update pi by averaging q, d by averaging the channel with weights p(v)q(h|v); the marginal factor cancels in the encoder normalization. Positive-sign gain is negative mean KL up to a v-dependent constant. Report true stochastic-code rate [H(H)-E_v H(q(.|v))]/log(2), its separate entropy components and achieved predictive score, never identify rate with log2 K. The physics law is estimated, population IB is not solved exactly.
onset: The symmetric uninformative encoder has a local splitting mode with critical cost sigma_max^2 for A[v,jy]=sqrt(p(v)/6)*(p(y|v,j)-m(y|j))/sqrt(m(y|j)). Report leading three Ritz values and leading residual after 40 block power iterations. This is a local curvature diagnostic of the shrunk channel, not a proof of global optimality or a guaranteed thermodynamic transition.
optimization: Locally optimize K=2,4,8. Independent annealed fits start from spectral plus random class directions, cool from max(target,0.86 onset) through the geometric midpoint to target and inject a small, seeded symmetry-breaking perturbation at each transition. Each constant-cost segment logs initial/final objective, minimum objective increment, monotonicity at 5e-12 tolerance, achieved iterations, weighted and maximum encoder total-variation fixed-point residual. Finite iteration budgets can give NONCONVERGED local candidates; compare continuation and independent seeding on the same deepening channel, record paired score difference. No unreported replacement of an unfavorable local optimum.
finite_ladder: Rounds 0..5 scan corners and axial at each b on 16 common anchors per training parent; for each K scan lambda/onset=.8,.28,.098. Then rotate through b=1,2,3 with common exposure ladder 64,256,1024,4096,8000 per parent. Within each range select the competitive mask; keep each range even if the pilot is inconclusive, so resolving weak effects does not require declaring a detection. Within that depth, find the nondominated validation frontier in achieved-rate/predictive-score space. Center on the highest lower endpoint minus .004 nats per achieved bit, or at every third level the greatest local score slope among interval-compatible frontier candidates for the selected mask. Center trials compare a frozen prior encoder initialization to an independent anneal. Add nearby flanking costs with shrinking geometric spacing and other K at center. After exhausting physical translations, rounds 21..32 revisit full-exposure knees with progressively finer costs and independent seeds, not new evidence or additional parents. Each invocation is one range/mask stage and records the full candidate list, reasons, eligible ancestors, optimized and validation diagnostics. Stop=true/last_round=32 is the machine-readable scan horizon. Other populations and parameterizations are not excluded by a poor or flat frontier.
score: On 128 fixed held-out centers per validation parent, integrate q(h|v) exactly before averaging log d(y|h,j); never use log of the decoder probability averaged over h. In expectation H(empirical target marginal per face)<=H(Y_j) by concavity even under site dependence. Thus pooled plug-in entropy plus frozen decoder mean logscore is an honest lower-score estimator IN EXPECTATION for a fixed model on independent parents, not a samplewise inequality or a postselection guarantee. Also report the stronger downward bias from separate entropies on 32 blocks, cross entropy, and gain relative to the training-marginal logscore (gain alone is not an MI bound). Achieved empirical rate uses the held-out marginal pi_val, concavity making it downward-biased in expectation; E KL(q(h|v)||pi_train) gives a complementary population upper rate in expectation. Curves must use achieved rates, not cardinality; dilution by encoder entropy is visible. A nonsignificant or negative lower score is inconclusive, not a negative information or an upper bound. Subtracting lower bounds cannot establish a true-MI difference.
face_mechanism: Let C=(number of A, number of B) on the four target sites. At every score, sum the SAME frozen 81-pattern decoder over each of the 15 compositions. Report Hhat(C|J)+E log d(C|H,J) and Hhat(Y|C,J)+E log[d(Y|H,J)/d(C|H,J)], with paired nulls and parent-group intervals. These sum exactly in point value to the full score. Each is separately a fixed-model lower-score estimator in expectation: conditional entropy of joint empirical frequencies is concave, and the decoder also factorizes conditionally. This distinguishes gross composition from spatial ordering within equal-composition squares; it does not prove a unique microscopic cause. Rates, fit prices, local onsets and selected maxima alone are not physical discoveries.
uncertainty: All repeated translations and all six J from each of 64 complete parents stay in one of 32 equally weighted disjoint blocks. Nominal two-sided 95% Student intervals on full-parent-block means. For nonlinear pooled target entropy or pooled H(H), estimate the SE by leave-one-block-out jackknife pseudovalues, centered at the original biased plug-in estimate, not a bias-corrected entropy estimate. No multiple-selection correction: common parents, anchor prefixes and tuned models are not independent replications. For the null, uniformly order each 64-parent same-beta block and cyclically derange target-parent identities; reuse exactly the same frozen decoder, frequencies, anchor slots, J and group. Report direct nulled lower score and paired logscore difference; the difference is NOT itself a lower bound. A systematically positive nulled bound indicates calibration trouble. Nominal intervals are not decision gates.
controls: On archived validation rows use an actual visible species indicator as a binary source B with measured fraction p. Independently corrupt its binary target with flip probabilities e=0,.15,.5 for each of six views; verify H_b(e+(1-2e)p)-H_b(e) in nats, including deterministic and pure-noise endpoints, using the identity encoder and known decoder. Compare measured achieved rate H_b(p)/ln2 to the constant encoder's exact zero rate. Iterate BA separately on this known two-state population channel at lambda=.08 and report its rate and relevance. This is a label calibration on physical rows, not generated configurations.
freeze_transfer: Confirm can be invoked after any completed cold prefix. Freeze highest utility among nondominated completed cold validation fits before opening temperatures 6/0, storing model ID, weight hash and release hash. Discovery refuses to continue after freezing. Score exactly the unchanged encoder and decoder on 256 validation anchors per parent at index 9 (reused cohort, not independent) and indices 6 and 0. Warm transfer is descriptive and does not select or tune, test generalization to new conditions is not a new primary significance claim.
persistence: Separate private --work and publishable --out. Cache one atomic training count archive per visited geometry with cumulative exposure and verified source hash; advance in slices of at most 32 centers per parent. Persist plans, completed model and block scores, and current BA iteration checkpoints. round-NNNN.partial.json is explicitly incomplete; round-NNNN.json signals success. Resume the same round with the same work/out. The frontier plot uses the completed prefix. Two BLAS threads suggested. Six counts archives total ~102 MB (uint32 x 2 splits x 6 faces x 81 outcomes x 3 buffers x [6561+2187]); finite private model files amount to well under 1 GB for this ladder. Live arrays are bounded by a single 131 MB underlying uint8 release, current conditional arrays and small count/translation/validation chunks, below 1 GB; no full translation-by-parent-by-face archive saved. No acquisition, no test fold or remote execution.
